title: Jimothy the raccoon shirts, mugs, stickers take over Etsy, Amazon - Fast Company
claim: Within about a week of the video, bootleg Jimothy tees, mugs, sticker packs and figurines were already on Etsy and Amazon (WebFetch blocked).
excerpt: Search summary: '90s superhero' style bootleg tees; mugs, sticker packs, hand-painted figurines; slogans like 'In a world full of trash pandas, be a Jimothy', 'if jimothy can i can', 'be kind of feral'.
